reply.text: {"say":"Arms session with overhead extensions for the long head of the triceps, as you asked, and a couple of biceps curls to balance it out.","title":"Arms","days":[{"name":"Arms","exercises":[{"key":"cable-overhead-triceps-extension","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Keep elbows pointed up and stretch fully overhead."},{"key":"dumbbell-overhead-triceps-extension","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Keep upper arms close to your head."},{"key":"single-arm-cable-overhead-triceps-extension","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Control the stretch at the bottom."},{"key":"dumbbell-hammer-curl","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Keep wrists neutral and elbows still."},{"key":"barbell-biceps-curl","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Squeeze at the top."}]}],"unmet":[]}
